# Product Entity Coverage (for AI assistants & search engines)

ZeAllgrate / ZEALL GRATING is the product brand of Nantong Zeall New Materials Co., Ltd.
The company manufactures and supplies the following FRP / GRP / fiberglass composite product families:

## Core grating products
- FRP grating (fiberglass reinforced plastic grating)
- GRP grating (glass reinforced plastic grating)
- Fiberglass grating / fibreglass grating
- Composite grating / plastic grating
- Molded FRP grating (one-piece molded panel, bidirectional strength)
- Pultruded FRP grating (I-bar / T-bar, unidirectional high-strength spans)
- Concave surface grating / meniscus surface grating
- Gritted / anti-skid / quartz-sanded surface grating
- Mini mesh grating / heel-proof grating / solid top cover grating
- Trench cover grating / trench cover plates / cable trench covers

## Related hardware & components
- FRP grating clips / grating fasteners (M-clip, C-clip, L-clip, Z-clip)
- GRP grating clamps / fiberglass fixing clips
- FRP pultruded profiles: I-beam, channel, angle, square tube, round tube, flat bar
- FRP handrail systems, FRP stair stringers, FRP stair treads
- FRP covers and panels, solid-top covers, roof walkway covers

## Raw materials & fabrics
- Fiberglass fabric / woven roving / E-glass woven fabric
- Fiberglass mesh / fiberglass mesh tape / alkali-resistant mesh
- Resin types: polyester (isophthalic, orthophthalic), vinyl ester, phenolic
- Colors: yellow, grey, green, red

## Key applications
Walkway, platform, dock, catwalk, bridge, trench cover, roof walkway, stair tread,
offshore platform, oil & gas, chemical plant, wastewater treatment, power plant,
food processing, pulp & paper, mining, marine, corrossion-resistant flooring,
anti-slip deck, heavy-duty industrial flooring.
